_comment: ACCEPTED axe FINDINGS, each with a reason.
tests/a11y.spec.ts asserts the violation set is EXACTLY this set, so an
accepted finding cannot be forgotten and a NEW one cannot appear unnoticed.
Nothing is silenced by disabling a rule — colour-contrast in particular
stays on, because this project has been burned by it three times.
Adding an entry here is a decision that needs a defence, not a way past a

accepted.reason: The ghost numeral is decorative texture at 5% ink, aria-hidden, carrying no information a reader needs — the beat number it echoes is printed legibly beside it in the micro register. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts incidental text that is pure decoration. Raising it to 4.5:1 would make it a second, competing headline, which is the opposite of what it is for.
accepted.alternative: the same number is stated in full contrast in the beat label on every section that carries a ghost
